ROOT.scriptdef: if exists(select * from sysobjects where name='PobierzKwotyPIK' and type='IF') drop function CDN.PobierzKwotyPIK;

CREATE FUNCTION CDN.PobierzKwotyPIK(@GIDNumer INT,@GIDTyp SMALLINT) RETURNS TABLE AS RETURN ( -- Add the SELECT statement with parameter references here SELECT PIE_GIDTyp, PIE_GIDFirma, PIE_GIDNumer, PIE_GIDLp, PIE_Znacznik, PIE_Kod, CASE WHEN PIE_Znacznik='D' THEN PIE_FrsId ELSE 0 END as FrSId,
SUM(CASE WHEN (PIK_Symbol IN(5,7,9,11,12,13,17,18) OR (PIK_Symbol IN(2,3,4,6,8,10,15,16) AND PIK_KosztFirma=1)) AND PIK_Rodzaj IN(1,2,4,6) THEN (CASE PIK_TypWyplaty when 2 THEN (CASE WHEN PIK_Kwota > 0 THEN 0 ELSE PIK_Kwota END)ELSE (CASE WHEN PIK_Kwota > 0 THEN PIK_Kwota ELSE 0 END) END) WHEN (PIK_Symbol IN(5,7,9,11,12,13,17,18) OR (PIK_Symbol IN(2,3,4,6,8,15,16) AND PIK_KosztFirma=1)) AND PIK_Rodzaj IN(7,8) THEN (CASE PIK_TypWyplaty when 2 THEN (CASE WHEN PIK_Kwota > 0 THEN 0 ELSE PIK_Kwota END)ELSE (CASE WHEN PIK_Kwota > 0 THEN PIK_Kwota ELSE 0 END) END) WHEN (PIK_Symbol = 10 AND PIK_KosztFirma=1) AND PIK_Rodzaj IN(7,8) THEN (CASE PIK_TypWyplaty when 2 THEN (CASE WHEN PIK_Kwota > 0 THEN PIK_Kwota ELSE 0 END)ELSE (CASE WHEN PIK_Kwota > 0 THEN 0 ELSE PIK_Kwota END) END) ELSE 0 END) as KosztCalkowity,
SUM(CASE WHEN (PIK_Symbol = 10 AND PIK_KosztFirma=1 AND PIK_Rodzaj IN(1,2,4,6) ) THEN (CASE PIK_TypWyplaty when 2 THEN (CASE WHEN PIK_Kwota > 0 THEN 0 ELSE PIK_Kwota END) ELSE (CASE WHEN PIK_Kwota > 0 THEN PIK_Kwota ELSE 0 END)END) WHEN (PIK_Symbol = 10 AND PIK_KosztFirma=1 AND PIK_Rodzaj IN(7,8)) THEN (CASE PIK_TypWyplaty when 2 THEN (CASE WHEN PIK_Kwota > 0 THEN (PIK_Kwota) ELSE 0 END) ELSE (CASE WHEN PIK_Kwota > 0 THEN 0 ELSE (PIK_Kwota) END) END)ELSE 0 END)as Netto,
SUM(CASE WHEN PIK_Symbol = 2 AND PIK_KosztFirma=1 AND PIK_Rodzaj IN(1,2,4,6,7,8) THEN (CASE PIK_TypWyplaty when 2 THEN (CASE WHEN PIK_Kwota > 0 THEN 0 ELSE PIK_Kwota END) ELSE (CASE WHEN PIK_Kwota > 0 THEN PIK_Kwota ELSE 0 END)END) ELSE 0 END) as Podatek,
SUM(CASE WHEN PIK_Symbol IN(5,7,9,11,12,13) AND PIK_Rodzaj IN(1,2,4,6,7,8) THEN (CASE PIK_TypWyplaty when 2 THEN (CASE WHEN PIK_Kwota > 0 THEN 0 ELSE PIK_Kwota END)ELSE (CASE WHEN PIK_Kwota > 0 THEN PIK_Kwota ELSE 0 END)END) ELSE 0 END) as ZUSPracodawcy,
SUM(CASE WHEN PIK_Symbol IN(3,4,6,8) AND PIK_Rodzaj IN(1,2,4,6,7,8) AND PIK_KosztFirma=1 THEN (CASE PIK_TypWyplaty when 2 THEN (CASE WHEN PIK_Kwota > 0 THEN 0 ELSE PIK_Kwota END)ELSE (CASE WHEN PIK_Kwota > 0 THEN PIK_Kwota ELSE 0 END)END) ELSE 0 END) as ZUSPracobiorcy,
SUM(CASE WHEN PIK_Symbol IN(2,3,4,6,8,10,15,16) AND PIK_KosztFirma=1 AND PIK_Rodzaj IN(1,2,4,6) THEN (CASE PIK_TypWyplaty when 2 THEN (CASE WHEN PIK_Kwota > 0 THEN 0 ELSE PIK_Kwota END)ELSE (CASE WHEN PIK_Kwota > 0 THEN PIK_Kwota ELSE 0 END)END) WHEN PIK_Symbol IN(2,3,4,6,8,15,16) AND PIK_KosztFirma=1 AND PIK_Rodzaj IN(7,8) THEN (CASE PIK_TypWyplaty when 2 THEN (CASE WHEN PIK_Kwota > 0 THEN 0 ELSE PIK_Kwota END)ELSE (CASE WHEN PIK_Kwota > 0 THEN PIK_Kwota ELSE 0 END)END) WHEN PIK_Symbol = 10 AND PIK_KosztFirma=1 AND PIK_Rodzaj IN(7,8) THEN (CASE PIK_TypWyplaty when 2 THEN (CASE WHEN PIK_Kwota > 0 THEN PIK_Kwota ELSE 0 END)ELSE (CASE WHEN PIK_Kwota > 0 THEN 0 ELSE PIK_Kwota END)END) ELSE 0 END) as Brutto,
SUM ( CASE WHEN (PIK_Symbol IN(2,3,4,5,6,7,8,9,11,12,13) OR (PIK_Symbol = 10 AND PIK_KosztFirma=1)) AND PIK_Rodzaj IN(1,2,4,6) THEN (CASE PIK_TypWyplaty WHEN 2 THEN (CASE WHEN PIK_Kwota < 0 THEN 0 ELSE PIK_Kwota END) ELSE (CASE WHEN PIK_Kwota < 0 THEN PIK_Kwota ELSE 0 END)END) WHEN (PIK_Symbol IN(2,3,4,5,6,7,8,9,11,12,13) AND PIK_Rodzaj IN(7,8) AND PIK_KosztFirma = 1) THEN (CASE PIK_TypWyplaty when 2 THEN (CASE WHEN PIK_Kwota < 0 THEN 0 ELSE PIK_Kwota END) --jesli niestornujaca ELSE (CASE WHEN PIK_Kwota > 0 THEN 0 ELSE PIK_Kwota END) END) WHEN (PIK_Symbol = 10 AND PIK_Rodzaj IN(7,8) AND PIK_KosztFirma = 1) THEN (CASE PIK_TypWyplaty when 2 THEN (CASE WHEN PIK_Kwota < 0 THEN PIK_Kwota ELSE 0 END) --jesli niestornujaca ELSE (CASE WHEN PIK_Kwota > 0 THEN PIK_Kwota ELSE 0 END) END)
ELSE 0 END ) as Zmniejszenia,
SUM(CASE WHEN PIK_Symbol IN(15,16) AND PIK_Rodzaj IN(1,2,6) THEN (CASE PIK_TypWyplaty when 2 THEN (CASE WHEN PIK_Kwota > 0 THEN 0 ELSE PIK_Kwota END)ELSE (CASE WHEN PIK_Kwota > 0 THEN PIK_Kwota ELSE 0 END)END) ELSE 0 END) as PPKPracobiorcy,
SUM(CASE WHEN PIK_Symbol IN(17,18) AND PIK_Rodzaj IN(1,2,6) THEN (CASE PIK_TypWyplaty when 2 THEN (CASE WHEN PIK_Kwota > 0 THEN 0 ELSE PIK_Kwota END)ELSE (CASE WHEN PIK_Kwota > 0 THEN PIK_Kwota ELSE 0 END)END) ELSE 0 END) as PPKPracodawcy
FROM CDN.PikElem LEFT OUTER JOIN CDN.PikKwoty ON PIK_GIDTyp=PIE_GIDTyp AND PIK_GIDNumer=PIE_GIDNumer AND PIK_GIDLp=PIE_GIDLp WHERE PIK_Rodzaj IN(1,2,4,6,7,8) AND PIE_GIDTyp = @GIDTyp AND PIE_GIDNumer = @GIDNumer GROUP BY PIE_GIDTyp, PIE_GIDFirma, PIE_GIDNumer, PIE_GIDLp, PIE_Znacznik, PIE_Kod, CASE WHEN PIE_Znacznik='D' THEN PIE_FrsId ELSE 0 END )
GRANT SELECT ON CDN.PobierzKwotyPIK TO CDNRaport
